blocks.content: Right rotations are used to solve LL imbalance.
The general process for right rotation on node y is:

items: The left child of the current node is promoted to become the new parent.
The original node (previous parent) is demoted to become the right child of the new parent.
The subtree that was originally to the right of the left child (before promotion) is now reattached as the left subtree of the demoted original node.
The subtree that was originally to the left of the new node retains its position.

blocks.content: If we examine the right rotation process, we can see that only three nodes are really affected.

items: y is the node with imbalance.
x is the left child of y.
z is the right child of x.
x is the parent of y.
y is the right child of x.
z is the left child of y.

blocks.content: In RR rotation, the affected nodes/subtrees are:

items: The imbalanced node (the node whose children are imbalanced).
The left child of the imbalanced node.
The right child/subtree of the left child of the imbalanced node.
